decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - Condition 3- The Council is satisfied that the proposed mortar/pointing would preserve or enhance the character and appearance of the listed building and the Cavalry Barracks Conservation Area, and is in compliance with policies ENV-B.2.7 Alterations to Listed Buildings and Buildings of Local Townscape Character, ENV-B.1.1 (All New Development) and ENV-B.2.2 (Conservation Areas) of the Unitary Development Plan.

Condition 8- The Council is satisfied that the details would preserve or enhance the character and appearance of the listed building and the Cavalry Barracks Conservation Area, and is in compliance with policies ENV-B.2.7 Alterations to Listed Buildings and Buildings of Local Townscape Character, ENV-B.1.1 (All New Development) and ENV-B.2.2 (Conservation Areas) of the Unitary Development Plan.

Condition 16
Reason:
The Council is satisfied that the overall building, roof and facade surveys are acceptable and would preserve or enhance the character and appearance of the listed building and the Cavalry Barracks Conservation Area, and is in compliance with policies ENV-B.2.7 Alterations to Listed Buildings and Buildings of Local Townscape Character, ENV-B.1.1 (All New Development) and ENV-B.2.2 (Conservation Areas) of the Unitary Development Plan
description: Details of mortar mix and pointing required by condition 3, details of features at a scale of at least 1:20 required by condition 8 and details of the surveys and the scope of works for the windows, brickwork, grilles, roof, floors and rainwater goods required by condition 16 of planning permission 00092/A/L11 dated 11/04/2011 for the internal creation of 81 bedrooms within the existing Grade II listed Hardinge Block.
